svg.title: AI-legible state modeling carries evidence into an accountable decision handoff
svg.desc: Five atlas-derived viewlets move from an event log through a component heatmap, a paced attention route, a human and AI handoff, and an audit trail with a retry checkpoint. The handoff carries signal, limits, evidence, affected population, boundary, named receiver, and a review and recovery route. Every state is written as well as colored.

g.title: Orientation: an interface should carry the decision handoff, not just display a result
g.text: ATLAS-DERIVED METHOD COMPANION · STATE → ATTENTION → ACCOUNTABILITY
When an interface carries the handoff
AI-legible state keeps the evidence, limits, affected people, and recovery route attached to the decision.

g.title: A paced attention route connects five fixed evidence surfaces without obscuring them
g.text: ATTENTION ROUTE · OBSERVE → CONTEXTUALIZE → ROUTE → HAND OFF → REVIEW / RECOVER

g.title: Stage one, Observe: an event log carries the signal and its evidence record
Stage two, Contextualize: a component heatmap locates the pattern and affected population in view
Stage three, Route: an anomaly alert marks where to look and carries limits and decision boundaries
Stage four, Hand off: the human and AI collaboration surface names the accountable receiver
Stage five, Review and recover: an audit trail preserves the route and a retry checkpoint enables a bounded return
g.text: Trace, return, and resume at a

g.title: The portable handoff packet preserves seven named fields and an inspectable data contract
g.text: PORTABLE HANDOFF PACKET · NO CONTEXT LEFT BEHIND
The decision arrives with what a collaborator needs to inspect it.
Color supports the scan; written labels preserve meaning in every mode.

g.title: Seven required handoff fields: signal, limits, evidence, affected population, boundary, named receiver, and review plus recovery
Each viewlet declares a stable identity, semantic role, accessible description, written state, and source
g.text: stable ID · semantic role · title + description · written state · source

g.title: The named receiver can inspect, compare, authorize, or return the packet to its checkpoint
g.text: inspect · compare · authorize · return to checkpoint

g.title: Provenance: geometry and state semantics are adapted from the AI-Legible Viewlet Atlas
g.text: SOURCE VOCABULARY · AI-LEGIBLE VIEWLET ATLAS · CANONICAL GEOMETRY + STATE SEMANTICS · RETOKENIZED FOR CONTEXT CANVAS
Written state names the context · anomalies mean look here.
